user_goal: Execute Forschungsbefehl 1 and advance the highest-information nonduplicate Global J-Space/vector-control discriminator.

authority.positive_claim_boundary: Actual model/runtime consumption plus exact identity, matched controls, disjoint holdout and reproducibility are required; prompt-only influence is insufficient.

reentry.nonduplication: This delta does not recreate the matched-control request builder. It closes the next pre-I/O problem: deterministic discovery/rejection of exact FREE routes from a captured OpenRouter catalog.

hypothesis.statement: A current exact OpenRouter FREE model route can satisfy zero prompt/completion price, explicit logit_bias/logprobs/seed support, public model-artifact identity, exact tokenizer binding and canonical economic admission simultaneously.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Current FREE variants split the required properties; a route may be free but omit logit_bias, or support logit_bias only on a paid variant, while the dynamic free router remains identity-ambiguous.
hypothesis.falsifier: A captured current OpenRouter catalog plus canonical economic provenance and an exact tokenizer binding yields at least one READY route under the fail-closed audit.

current_external_evidence.finding: openai/gpt-oss-20b:free has prompt/completion price 0 and public Hugging Face identity, but its current supported_parameters omit logit_bias; the paid openai/gpt-oss-20b route lists logit_bias and nonzero pricing.
nvidia/nemotron-nano-9b-v2:free has prompt/completion price 0 and public Hugging Face identity, but its current supported_parameters omit logit_bias and logprobs.
inclusionai/ling-3.0-tiny:free is a current zero-price model with public Hugging Face identity and seed/logprobs, but its current supported_parameters omit logit_bias.

require_parameters can exclude providers that do not support all request parameters and allow_fallbacks controls fallback behavior; these routing controls do not themselves create model/tokenizer identity.

canonical_economic_boundary.finding: Canonical economic provenance currently admits only the dynamic openrouter/free route, so no exact model-specific OpenRouter route is execution-ready even if a catalog candidate otherwise supports the requested parameters.

scope_warning: The external candidate audit is targeted, not an exhaustive proof that no current FREE catalog route can ever qualify. The new deterministic catalog auditor exists specifically to make future full-catalog snapshots exhaustive and reproducible without provider model I/O.

writes.scope: Network-free captured-catalog audit. READY requires exact non-dynamic model id, exact zero prompt/completion price, logit_bias+logprobs+seed support, exact tokenizer id+SHA256, and exact-route economic admission.

Seven fail-closed unit regressions covering zero-price without logit_bias, paid route, dynamic router, missing economic admission, missing tokenizer binding, candidate filtering and the complete READY positive fixture.

scientific_result.meaning: The hosted output-logit lane is not currently execution-ready from the audited routes. FREE status alone is insufficient, and parameter support on a paid sibling route cannot be transferred to the FREE variant.
scientific_result.next_exact_action: Feed a fresh full OpenRouter model-catalog snapshot into the new network-free auditor. If no READY route exists under exact economic and tokenizer bindings, keep hosted output-logit steering blocked and execute the primary local Qwen3-0.6B residual/cvec control-family T1 on an authorized zero-cost intervention-capable runtime.
